mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a month indicates a weakening labor market, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced consumer spending and economic slowdown.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between UNRATE increases and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening demand environment, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings expectations are revised downward.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of periods with declining GDP, or the correlation between GDP growth and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in industrial production by more than 1% in a month signals a strong supply-side response, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as increased production capacity supports economic growth and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the correlation between INDPRO increases and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.3% in a month and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000, it signals a strengthening labor market, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer confidence and spending increase.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE decreases > 0.3% and PAYEMS increases > 200,000 in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint effect of UNRATE and PAYEMS on SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% in a month, coupled with a decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS), signals an expansionary demand environment supported by monetary policy, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as construction activity and related sectors benefit.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases > 5% and FEDFUNDS decreases in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint effect of HOUST and FEDFUNDS on SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment, indicated by CPIAUCSL remaining below 2% for three consecutive months, signals a benign monetary policy, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate continued low interest rates and stable economic conditions.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of periods with low inflation, or the correlation between low CPIAUCSL and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 1% in a month, coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE), signals a strengthening consumer demand environment, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as consumer spending supports corporate earnings.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases > 1% and UNRATE decreases in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint effect of RSAFS and UNRATE on SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
